# Realisability, costs and input-size account

Status: supplement to DERIVED_INTERFACE_v1.md for design review. Ordinary mathematical construction; no executable code.

## 1. The source-assignment family is generated by the grammar

The read-cost theorem must not introduce independently flippable labels which no admitted source could have.

For any finite n and binary vector x, construct a source with neutral root r and n consecutive sections. Section i has one of two explicit opening role tokens: own-assertion if x_i=1, or reported-speaker if x_i=0. It contains one fixed proposition occurrence p_i and closes. Give its context origin the key o_i. The scope-event skeleton for every section is enter(o_i), emit(p_i), leave; its omitted opening-role token determines theta(o_i).

This construction realises all 2^n label assignments while keeping the same scope shape, source-order coordinates, origin-equality pattern and proposition strings. Every copy of section i inherits the same x_i. An assignment never permits one copied occurrence of o_i to have a different role from another. Distinct synthetic source snapshots have distinct content; the oracle model does not require a digest collision.

The receiver is supplied the shape, source-origin equality dictionary and read-window index, but not these opening-role tokens. This is a restricted evidence-access experiment, not a claim that actual philology has 2^n ambiguous parses. The genuine source fixture has its actual fixed wording; it is a separate scope-fidelity control.

Nested structure can be added without changing the role independence: surround each selected emit by a balanced, unselected inner report and then return before emitting. Alternatively, cut after entering the inner report and place the leave/selected-emit suffix in the other branch. The selected emission then requires the restored o_i, rather than the presently active inner context. Thus every hard/cover instance can be realised with the same suspended-context mechanism, not only as an abstract table unrelated to the grammar.

## 2. Explicit carrier-card construction

For a Set Cover instance with universe U={1,...,n}, m subsets S_j and budget k, use the preceding source family. Construct card j by concatenating source-backed transclusions of the sections with i in S_j, retaining each original key o_i. Each card is one contiguous block in the derived carrier. The card menu permits one entire block read at a time; no read can straddle blocks or access the retired original source. The coverage dictionary publicly lists each card's original keys, but the role witnesses are available only on reading that card.

The selected next-attribution task contains one selected occurrence for every universe element. These occurrences can be in a separate output catalogue whose role dependencies are obtained by the open-fragment effects; the catalogue is not itself a readable role-witness card. An occurrence with zero supporting cards makes the instance impossible, as does an uncovered universe element in Set Cover.

Every x creates a concrete source and concrete cards by these copying/concatenation operations. All repeated roles remain globally consistent. On the all-own-assertion source, a correct total receiver decision requires a covering family of read cards. Therefore a worst-case budget-k policy exists exactly when the original cover instance has a cover of size at most k. Conversely the selected cover gives such a policy. This yields NP-hardness of budget feasibility, and membership in NP follows from the finite cover certificate and the read-cost equivalence. We use the established NP-completeness of Set Cover; no new combinatorial hardness method is claimed.

The construction changes the surviving access service. If the successor can still read original-source intervals or arbitrarily chosen subwindows spanning several cards, the reduction no longer describes its holdings/menu. Merely printing the cards in a convenient order does not revoke an already available source service.

## 3. Charge copies and the origin dictionary

Let M=sum_j |S_j|. The unpadded construction contains n source contexts, M explicit transclusion occurrences, m card boundaries, and n selected output references. The source-origin dictionary has n entries. Every occurrence reference uses an origin index taking O(log(n+1)) bits, in addition to the declared source/snapshot locator record.

Thus the syntactic construction has O(n+m+M) nodes and O((n+m+M) log(n+m+1)) indexing bits, plus the actual locator/witness-format bytes. There is no implicit exponential family of copies. The 2^n assignments describe possible source contents for the lower-bound argument, not a stored corpus which the protocol claims to enumerate cheaply.

The derived effect of a fragment stores selected emission references, a finite residual origin prefix, an incoming-tail offset, and depth bounds. Its reference count is bounded by the selected emissions plus unmatched local enter operations, with integer indices for incoming slots. Constructing it and determining source equality still consumes the explicit fragment and identity-dictionary input. Reporting only |L| while ignoring M or the dictionary would understate input cost.

## 4. One read is not automatically one byte

The basic theorem accepts arbitrary positive declared read costs. Unit card cost models one request/approval/round, not a physically constant byte or time cost for arbitrarily long cards.

For an equal-response-length contrast, let s=max_j |S_j| and pad every card to s entries with copies of a distinguished irrelevant context z. The selected task never depends on z. Then each card contains exactly s fixed-width origin/role entries, plus a common envelope. The construction has O(n+ms) nodes, which is polynomial in the cover instance size. If the read cost is the response length, every card has the same cost B and budget kB again gives exactly the cover question. Padding does not create an extra informative window, and the successor still reads only complete card blocks.

Real authentication can add signatures, hashes, proofs, source coordinates and verification cost. Those bytes and operations must be charged if the implementation claims a byte/time bound. The mathematics does not supply a cryptographic protocol or claim the role bit alone is an adequate witness.

## 5. Alternative holdings and cost controls

- A free or cost-1 whole-source read can make the chosen instance trivial. It must be added if actually available.
- An available role witness for an origin removes that origin from the unresolved set; an already known negative answers the conjunction immediately.
- A valid task-specific verdict or independently checkable source certificate may remove the need for the raw role reads. The theorem does not assert an information lower bound against such additional evidence.
- Arbitrary singleton queries give another feasible cover and can change the optimum. Cheap singletons alone do not necessarily make optimising a mixed menu trivial, but they bound the cost by their total.
- If a query right cannot pass to the successor, its window is absent from the successor menu. That is a supplied access fact, not a theorem creating or revoking permission.
- A policy may terminate early after finding a nonauthor role. This can reduce realised or expected cost, but not the worst-case all-positive cost proved here.
- An always-unresolved output has zero read cost and is sound as a withholding response. It does not satisfy the stipulated total-decision completion requirement.

## 6. What this comparison says about continuation

It can matter which access service survives a handoff even when all of the same underlying source facts still exist somewhere. Keeping the origin-coordinate service preserves a structured interval optimisation problem. Keeping only source-backed excerpt-card retrieval can preserve eventual decidability while changing optimal source reacquisition to a covering problem with arbitrary incidence. Losing every route to a live origin prevents completion under the declared holdings.

This is a difference in accessible evidence organisation and bounded decision cost. It is not an increase in independent testimonial support, a claim that duplicates are more trustworthy, or an assertion that complex retrieval invalidates an already warranted conclusion. It becomes relevant only when the successor actually lacks the required context evidence and must obtain it under the stated access contract.

## 7. Fixed-width source and witness encoding

For the locality-controlled synthetic family, implement the two role tokens as equal-width labels such as ROLE0 and ROLE1 (or a fixed one-bit field with a public interpretation). Proposition payloads, context-key fields, scope markers and record padding are identical across assignments. All source offsets, card lengths, request costs and public menu entries are therefore assignment-independent. Role witnesses use fixed-size local records plus opaque fixed-format binding fields. The model excludes label-dependent response timing, status, signature bytes interpreted as semantic data, or whole-source content-address lookup.

This restriction realizes the complete-transcript star premise. It is not a claim that arbitrary natural-language descriptions have constant length or that real cryptographic encodings cannot leak information. Any such actual channel must be added to the observation contract before applying the bound.

## 8. Global-force coherence of the generated family

The independently varied selected contexts are sibling sections under the neutral document root, not arbitrary nested frames. Any inserted inner report has fixed nonauthorial document-global force, irrespective of its parent's role. Returning from that report restores the parent's varied role. Thus the construction does not claim that naming the author inside an outer quotation creates original-document authorial force, and it does not require independently varying semantic labels which quotation containment would constrain. For a different source with correlated nested roles, the star condition must be checked at that source-model scope rather than inferred from mere presence of several keys.
